stem: Voltmarkt counts stock at the end of each day, after that day's sales. A security camera sold its last unit at 11:00 on Monday, and the shelf stayed empty until a delivery arrived before opening on Tuesday. Tuesday ended with 12 units in stock. How many stockout days does the convention record for Monday and Tuesday?

options.text: None: the camera was in stock on Monday morning
One: Monday, which closed with 0 units
Two: Monday and Tuesday, until the delivery was unpacked
Half a day: Monday from 11:00 until the store closed
